title: Niagara Falls by Night with Tunnel and Fireworks
includes: Fully Guided Tour of Niagara Falls at Night
Niagara Parks Power Station Tunnel (Admission Included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience Niagara Falls after dark on this immersive small-group walking tour. Begin at Skylon Tower, where you’ll meet your guide before heading to the Falls via the scenic Incline Railway.

At the Niagara Parks Power Station, descend into the historic tunnel leading to a viewing platform at the edge of the Niagara River. From here, take in incredible views of the illuminated Horseshoe Falls and the nightly fireworks.

Continue with a guided walk along the Niagara Parkway, passing the Old Scow, Table Rock Welcome Centre, and stunning viewpoints of Horseshoe, American, and Bridal Veil Falls.

End your evening at the Illumination Tower Control Room, where you’ll have the chance to change the colours of the Falls for a memorable, interactive finale.
